integrity: All equations are proved in the accompanying manuscript and checked separately by exact rational enumeration; the finite checks are not a substitute for proof. No claim of external certification or independent validation is made.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to affine attachment with nonnegative fixed reinforcement and finite growing rooted increasing trees. It does not prove conditional stochastic order, results for nonlinear kernels, or uniformity as the reinforcement tends to zero with tree size. Earlier marginal enumerators may admit an alternative derivation; historical priority is not independently certified.
title: Reinforcement creates a strict arrival-time hierarchy of leaf covariances in growing recursive trees
